overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Multiline Auto -- single-line areas truncate end-of-line words with no line returns; multiline areas get automatic line returns
Multiline Yes -- single-line areas display up to the first carriage return/last full word and can be scrolled; multiline areas get automatic line returns
Multiline No -- text is always shown on a single row; text after the first carriage return is removed once the area is modified

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, the Multiline property (word-wrap / hard line-return handling) of the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: Has no effect if applied to an object that does not support the Multiline property.
